name: simple-product-feeds
description: Operate Shopify product feeds from your agent: diagnose feed health, see every product across its feeds, trace any row through the transformation pipeline, fix with preview-first writes (including bulk add / exclude / label from a set of products), publish, and verify; run Catalog Experiments (hold back products from a destination and read what it does for their sales) — via the Simple Product Feeds remote MCP server (22 tools) and the bundled feed-ops and catalog-experiments skills.
